I stayed in Caspia hotel this week as I was in Delhi to attend a marriage.
The hotel is mid sized and has pretty good rooms for the price. There were all amenities in the room as any higher star rated hotel except iron.
A large window was providing ample light in the room as well as nice view of national highway.
Sleep quality was truly good with good quality mattress of approx 12 inch,  and providing comfortable sleeping position in any way,  pose.
Food quality was truly good at this price range.
Morning was great for the price range. There was good variety of breakfast items suitabke for Indians as well as Europeans.
Internet speed was a bit below than average,  but acceptable
Recommended by me.

Good hotel for 3-star level.

Pros: Rooms are nice, comfortable, and clean. Service is good and friendly. No roaches or bugs in the rooms and hallways. Restaurant is clean and food is good.

Cons: Hallways and Lobby seem a bit dirty/dusty. Mosquitos are present in the lobby.

I recently stayed at Caspia Hotel in Haiderpur Village for two nights while attending a friend’s daughter’s wedding. It’s a mid-sized hotel with small rooms and compact bathrooms, along with a basic lobby area. While the spaces are modest, the hotel does provide all the essential amenities, making it a functional choice for short stays.

The food quality was slightly above average; it wasn’t extraordinary but was satisfactory for the occasion. The highlight of my experience was the hospitality – the staff were genuinely nice and accommodating, which added a positive touch to the stay.
